name: DeadBot Diagnostic Plugin
description: AGPLv3 plugin for G-Assist. Exposes system metrics, diagnostic (diagnose_env), real-time graph, and log export for streamers, reviewers, and crowd gamers.
author: ElSerda & Contributors

functions.name: initialize
functions.description: Initializes the DeadBot plugin (startup routines, config load).

functions.name: shutdown
functions.description: Shuts down the DeadBot plugin, saves state and cleanup.

functions.name: diagnose_env
functions.description: Runs full diagnostic on system metrics (uses params['metrics'] if provided, else live scan).

metrics.description: System metrics dict (cpu, ram, disk, gpu, vram, etc).

functions.name: show_graph
functions.description: Displays a real-time graph of system metrics (matplotlib, may block).

duration.description: Duration in seconds for graph display.

functions.name: export_log
functions.description: Exports the latest system scan as CSV or JSON.

path.description: Destination path for exported log file.
